data.one_liner: Android implementation of the image_picker plugin for selecting photos and videos.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Android side of the image_picker federated plugin. It uses the Android Photo Picker when possible and can resize images during decoding. It exposes APIs to enable the new photo‑picker features on older Android versions.
use_when: You need to pick images or videos on Android devices
You want native resizing to avoid large memory usage
You rely on the Android Photo Picker for a consistent UI
avoid_when: Your app runs only on iOS or web
You prefer a single cross‑platform package without platform‑specific code
You need advanced editing or cropping features
strengths: Uses the system Photo Picker for a native experience
Endorsed federated plugin, auto‑included with image_picker
weaknesses: Advanced features require manual import and setup
Limited to the capabilities of the Android Photo Picker
data.setup_notes: Add image_picker to pubspec (this plugin is auto‑included). Ensure Android manifest has CAMERA and READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions if needed. To enable the optional Photo Picker on API <=15, import the package and set ImagePickerAndroid.useAndroidPhotoPicker = true before calling image_picker APIs.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Single package that works on Android, iOS, and web without needing platform‑specific imports
